date: "2026-10-15"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr)
```

## Load from web
```{r}
url = "https://www.samhsa.gov/data/sites/default/files/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015.htm"
drug_use_html = read_html(url)

drug_use_html |>
  html_table()
```

```{r}
table_marj =
  drug_use_html |> 
  html_table() |> 
  first()
```
